envelope.description: File seam and the file store's core: files, read, list and appending save

body.title: File seam and the file store's core: files, read, list and appending save
body.summary: New vscode-plugin/src/chat/session-file-store.ts: the SessionFilesFs interface with nodeSessionFilesFs, and createFileChatSessionStore implementing ChatSessionStore over `<root>/<sessionFileName(id)>.head.json` and `.rows.ndjson`. Per-object tracking of the rows on disk; save appends the rows beyond the object's count and replaces the head through a temporary file and a rename, head after rows; draft writes nothing and create saves at once; get reads once and returns the same object while the files are unchanged; list reads heads only; a damaged head reads as absent; a torn last rows line is dropped and cut back, a bad middle line skipped; an id is stored under sessionFileName(id) and read back with its real id. Includes the in-memory recording fake used by the tests.
acceptanceChecks: A save of a session holding 1,000 stored rows and one new row appends exactly that row and replaces the head; the bytes written do not grow with the stored rows
A save with no new rows writes the head only
draft() writes nothing until its first save; create() saves at once
get() returns every row variant, editMode, mode, nativeSessionId and liveTurn unchanged, and the same object on a second call without reading the files again
list() reads head files only and returns id, provider, title and updatedAt sorted by updatedAt descending
A damaged head is absent from get and list; a torn last line is dropped and the file cut back before the next append; a bad middle line is skipped
An id with characters outside A-Za-z0-9_- is stored under sessionFileName(id) and read back with its real id

tests.name: a save of a session with new rows appends exactly those rows to the rows file and replaces the head; the bytes written do not grow with the rows already stored (1,000 stored rows, one new row)
a save with no new rows writes the head only
a draft writes nothing until its first save, which writes its rows and then its head; create() saves at once
get returns the saved session with every row variant, editMode, mode, nativeSessionId and liveTurn unchanged, and the same object on a second call without reading the files again
list reads head files only, never a rows file, and returns id, provider, title and updatedAt sorted by updatedAt descending
a damaged head reads as no session and is left out of list; a rows file with a torn last line is read without it and cut back before the next append; a bad line in the middle is skipped
an id with characters outside A-Za-z0-9_- is stored under sessionFileName(id) and read back with its real id
